title: Get to know Reports: Cash Closing, Daily Collections and more
summary: Tour of Cash Closing, Daily Collections, Accounts Receivable and Quote Status: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Reports
steps.details: We'll go through Cash Closing, Daily Collections, Accounts Receivable and Quote Status.

steps.title: Cash Closing
steps.details: Each cash session in the period: opening, payments per payment method, expenses and closing differences. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Daily Collections
steps.details: Everything collected in the period by payment method, doctor and branch: to check the day's cash. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Accounts Receivable
steps.details: Each patient's balance: what was invoiced, what was collected and what they owe. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Quote Status
steps.details: Quotes issued, accepted, rejected and pending, with their conversion rate. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».
